description: Terminal record emitted by the gov-municipality final_sign_off Pregel cell. Confirms all 5 construction-phase inspections passed and the jurisdiction granted occupancy / completion approval. Carries the municipal authority witness signature (G3 minLength 1, witness DID MUST differ from submitter DID) and the 30-day public notice window's start + end timestamps (G9 structural — `publicNoticePeriodEndsAt - publicNoticePeriodStartsAt` MUST be ≥ 30 days). Cited by the parent tatekata mission's commissioning gate as authoritative permit completion. Per ADR-2605250800 + gates G2 (IPFS-pinned), G3 (witness), G5 (Charter Rider), G9 (30-day public notice).

submitterDid.description: DID of the original applicant. MUST differ from each `municipalAuthorityWitnessSignatures[].witnessDid` (G3 independence).

inspectionScheduleId.description: Reference to the inspectionSchedule record this finalization aggregates.

phaseInspectionsPassed.description: Per-phase pass records. Schema enforces exactly 5 phases (foundation / structural / mep / finishing / commissioning) — short-circuit finalization is not permitted.

finalApprovalIssuedAt.description: Timestamp the jurisdiction issued the final occupancy / completion approval.

finalApprovalDocumentIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the jurisdiction-issued completion document (signed PDF or equivalent).

municipalAuthorityWitnessSignatures.description: G3 structural: at least one municipal authority witness signature. Each witnessDid MUST differ from submitterDid.

publicNoticePeriodStartsAt.description: G9: start of the 30-day public-objection window.

publicNoticePeriodEndsAt.description: G9: end of the 30-day public-objection window. Validator MUST enforce `publicNoticePeriodEndsAt - publicNoticePeriodStartsAt >= 30 days`.

publicNoticeIpfsCid.description: G2+G9: IPFS CID of the public notice as posted (text + jurisdiction-issued publication channel reference).

publicObjectionsRaised.description: Count of formal public objections received during the notice window. Non-zero requires cited resolution attestations in `publicObjectionResolutionCids`.

publicObjectionResolutionCids.description: If publicObjectionsRaised > 0, one resolution CID per objection. Required if publicObjectionsRaised > 0.

slotReference.description: Links to the inspectionSchedule.slots[].slotReference for this phase.

inspectorWitnessSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over (permitApplicationId + phase + slotReference + passedAt) by the inspector's witness DID.

deficienciesAddressedCid.description: Optional IPFS CID if the phase initially failed inspection and was re-inspected; documents the deficiencies + remediation.

witnessDid.description: DID of the municipal authority witness. MUST differ from the record's submitterDid.

officeReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-internal office reference (e.g. department / officer ID). PII filter applies — no personal names.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (permitApplicationId + finalApprovalIssuedAt + finalApprovalDocumentIpfsCid + publicNoticePeriodEndsAt).
